items.title: File Klage with the Verwaltungsgericht against the rejection
items.quote: Die Klage muss binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle erhoben werden.
items.computation: The one-month Klage period runs from the day the Bescheid is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe). Under §§ 41, 43 VwVfG NRW a letter posted by an authority is normally deemed delivered on the third day after posting (recent practice for items posted since 2025 often uses four days), and the one-month period under § 74 VwGO would then be counted per §§ 187, 188 BGB from that day, with a Sunday/holiday/Saturday shift to the next business day if the last day falls on such a day. However, this letter carries no printed issue date (no 'Musterstadt, den ...' line), only the applicant's application date of 02.07.2026 and today's reference date of 21.07.2026. Without a document date there is no reliable anchor for the deemed-delivery calculation, so the exact deadline cannot be computed; it could fall anywhere depending on the actual posting date, which is not stated in the letter.

warnings: The letter has no printed issue date (no 'Musterstadt, den ...' line), so the deemed-delivery (Bekanntgabe) date and therefore the exact one-month Klage deadline cannot be calculated; the recipient should check the envelope postmark or any cover note for the actual sending date and count one month from three (or four) days after that.
This is a rejection of the special-use permit application itself (Sondernutzungserlaubnis for a moving container); it does not impose any payment demand.
